content:
Create instructions for multiple scanners to perform.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
Enum: "true"
"false"
Indicates whether or not to send the directives to all scanners.
Array of strings
An array of scanner UUIDs to send the directives to.
object
Specifies the instructions you wish to send to the scanners. The
directive  object is different depending on whether you want to restart
the scanners' service or change settings for the scanners.
